instances.query:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into cabudges. Here are the actions I can do

Mentan a block
Uncabudge a block from on top of another block
Grafor a block
Cabudge a block on top of another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only mentan or uncabudge one block at a time.
I can only mentan or uncabudge a block if my hand is empty.
I can only mentan a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not mentanned.
I can only uncabudge a block from on top of another block if the block I am uncabudging was really on top of the other block.
I can only uncabudge a block from on top of another block if the block I am uncabudging is clear.
Once I mentan or uncabudge a block, I am holding the block.
I can only grafor a block that I am holding.
I can only cabudge a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being cabudged.
I can only cabudge a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am cabudging the block is clear.
Once I grafor or cabudge a block, my hand becomes empty.
Once you cabudge a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the michime block is clear, the westoor block is clear, the hand is empty, the facizer block is on top of the tegust block, the westoor block is on top of the facizer block, the michime block is on the table and the tegust block is on the table.
My goal is to have that the facizer block is on top of the tegust block and the michime block is on top of the facizer block.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
instances.ground_truth_plan:
